advisories.title: No deformers exist
advisories.detail: Modeling is limited to per-part transform keys.
advisories.recommendation: Create head/body/face connection deformers before tuning detailed poses.

advisories.title: Neck bridge is missing
advisories.detail: Expected a connection deformer like neck-bridge-deformer.
advisories.recommendation: 首上部と首根元に左右/中央のピンキーを追加し、顔角度と体角度を分けて接続部を追従させる。

advisories.title: Outline pins is missing
advisories.detail: Expected a connection deformer like outline-pin-deformer.
advisories.recommendation: 左右の顎/頬ピンをミラーリンクし、ParamAngleX の左右キーを比較しながら輪郭の3D感を調整する。

advisories.title: Shoulder bridge is missing
advisories.detail: Expected a connection deformer like shoulder-bridge-deformer.
advisories.recommendation: 首下、襟、左右肩の固定ピンを分け、体角度では肩側、顔角度では首側だけが追従するキーを作る。

advisories.title: Many visible image parts do not inherit a deformer
advisories.detail: 5 of 5 visible image parts have no direct or inherited deformer assignment.
advisories.recommendation: For parts that should move with head/body, assign their parent group or branch to an existing deformer before fine modeling.

advisories.title: ParamEyeLOpen has no eyelid pin keys
advisories.detail: Blink/wink currently appears to be driven by transform bindings rather than curved eyelid deformation.
advisories.recommendation: Add eyelid warp pins or mesh pins so blinks close along the eyelid curve instead of only scaling.

advisories.title: ParamEyeROpen has no eyelid pin keys
advisories.detail: Blink/wink currently appears to be driven by transform bindings rather than curved eyelid deformation.
advisories.recommendation: Add eyelid warp pins or mesh pins so blinks close along the eyelid curve instead of only scaling.

advisories.title: Tracking section is missing
advisories.detail: Camera input cannot be audited until tracking mappings exist.
advisories.recommendation: Create tracking mappings after the model deformation pass is stable.

nextSteps: Freeze neutral and representative poses, then begin tracking gain calibration.
